name: Escape The Sex Room
source: You wake up with your two best friends in underwear. Your former best friend has locked you all in, and the only way out is to complete the sexual challenges she imposes while she gets off watching everything you do. Will the three of you manage to escape?
translation: 一觉醒来，你和两个最好的朋友全都只穿着内衣被关在房间里。你们昔日的挚友把你们锁在了这里，唯一的脱身之道便是完成她定下的一道道色情挑战，而她则在一旁看着你们的一举一动自得其乐。你们三人究竟能否成功逃脱？
